summary: QSRSoft is a bootstrapped QSR back-office, food-safety, and labor-analytics software provider generating an estimated $18.5M in annual recurring revenue as of 2024, with no outside venture funding raised. (Scope note: Revenue figure is a third-party estimate, not a company-disclosed financial statement.)
Tim Burge has served as CEO of QSRSoft since February 2015; he previously spent more than 22 years in operations roles at McDonald's before joining QSRSoft.
QSRSoft was recognized by QSR Magazine as a top food-safety solution provider, reflecting its positioning in food-safety compliance software for multi-unit QSR operators.
